name: AgentStalker
description: A standardized agent vulnerability benchmark, formal taint tracking proofs, and a cross-language unified AST model, integrating code auditing with sandbox reproduction into an all-in-one agent security approach. 一个标准化的 Agent 漏洞基准、形式化的污点追踪证明与跨语言的统一 AST 模型，集成代码审计到沙箱复现一体化的智能体安全范式。
